title: Renew a qualified supervisor certificate
summary: You can renew your qualified supervisor certificate online if you meet the eligibility requirements.
intro:
You can apply to renew your qualified supervisor certificate online, provided you meet the eligibility requirements.

To renew your certificate if you do not meet the requirements visit a Service NSW Centre.

To find your qualified supervisor certificate number and details visit Verify NSW.

### If your certificate has expired

You cannot trade until your new certificate is issued.
who_can_apply: You want to seek an exemption from continuing professional development (CPD) obligations.
You need to make changes to your licence other than your contact details and address.
You cannot renew online if the changes are other than contact details and address.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your registration.
